values.value: Duplicates — among sampled records, an exact case-insensitive match on the object's Email or Phone field (whichever it has) counts every record in that matched group as a duplicate. An object where 5% or more of its sampled records are duplicates is flagged Warning on the breakdown/heatmap; 10% or more is Critical. Contributes 30% of the composite Data Health score, proportional to its org-wide duplicate rate.
